author: Agathe Verhulst
html:
Hoi Brüederli!
How awsome! There are so many hidden places on this earth with so much energy in them!
Just a simple thing like darkness can show us how the power of nature just goes beyond our imagination.
We can try to tame it with electronic devices but in the end we see just how small we are compared to this thing we call home: planet earth.

author: Fab
html: That is really an awesome read. Feels like being there and definitely similar feelings, that would have been created in this mind. There seems to be an interesting connection between the Ganzfeld experiment and the shade, that has been seen. Could that be?

author: Basile
html: Interesting, I had not heard of that experiment before! I don’t think it was telepathy, but I believe that the mind is capable of unexpected, amazing things when deprived of sensory input! Light deprivation has been used a meditation technique by chinese monks…
